# Closet

> Private, self-hosted household wardrobe organizer. Catalog garments with photos, build outfits, schedule them on a calendar, and share a wardrobe between users.

## What It Is

Closet is a self-hosted fork of Libre Closet (AGPL-3.0). It runs as a server-rendered progressive web app on your own hardware; data stays in a PostgreSQL database.

## Routes

- / - Today, the home screen
- /wardrobe - garment catalog
- /outfits - saved outfits and the outfit composer
- /calendar - outfit schedule
- /about - about and license attribution
- /auth/login - sign in (always required)

## Tech Stack

- Fastify 5 (TypeScript), server-rendered JSX (hono/jsx), no client framework
- htmx, Tailwind + daisyUI
- PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM)
- Server-side background removal (BiRefNet on ONNX runtime, in a child process); photos are processed on the server, never in the browser
- Workbox service worker, Web Push
- Photos stored on local disk
